title: Timely Payments in income tax Self Assessment
text: This consultation seeks views on implementing more timely payment in Income Tax Self Assessment ( ITSA ), following the Budget 2025 announcement of changes to payment timings for those with Pay As You Earn ( PAYE ) income from April 2029. It considers how implementation could work for those with PAYE income, and explores the potential for more timely payment options for other ITSA taxpayers.
changeNote: Published outcome, including summary of responses.
